verdict.rationale: Order status and tracking is a fair axis for an agentic-payments protocol, especially one that integrates with merchant checkout via Payment Acceptance. However, the evidence never documents any way for a buyer agent to look up an order's status or tracking after purchase. The only post-payment behavior shown is the facilitator reporting the settlement result to the seller's resource server and the server returning the resource with a confirmation inside the same request. That is a one-off, in-request receipt, not a later order-lifecycle lookup.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase
